name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Interchangeable Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a sturdy structure with a charming decorative look.
    - Built with a 2-layer wooden design for added depth, dimension, and visual appeal.
    - Layer 1 is made from 5mm wood, creating a solid and durable base.
    - Layer 2 and the interchangeable charm pieces are made from 3mm wood, helping the design stay lightweight while still durable.
    - Includes a hanging rope for easy display.
    - Comes with disc magnets to hold and swap interchangeable pieces conveniently.
    - Finished with 1-sided printing for clear details and vibrant seasonal artwork.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
            +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
            +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
            +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
            +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
            +) 14 x 14 in ~ 35.56 x 35.56 cm
            +) 16 x 16 in ~ 40.64 x 40.64 cm
            +) 18 x 18 in ~ 45.72 x 45.72 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for clear details, vibrant colors, and a polished decorative appearance.
    - Uses 1-sided printing on all visible wooden pieces.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative hanging sign for seasonal, holiday, or personalized home display.
    - Perfect for decorating front doors, walls, entryways, classrooms, nurseries, or indoor spaces.
    - The interchangeable design allows users to refresh the look without replacing the whole sign.
    - Great for themed collections such as Halloween, Christmas, birthdays, baby milestones, or personalized family décor.
    - Combines decorative value with fun customization.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for family members, friends, teachers, couples, and home décor lovers.
    - Perfect for housewarming gifts, birthdays, holidays, Halloween décor, seasonal decorating, and personalized gifts.
    - Great for anyone who enjoys unique handcrafted décor with interchangeable features.
    - A charming gift choice that combines personalization, decoration, and creativity.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Interchangeable Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
